Today, there are updates on the November cyclone for the Chennai–Puducherry coast and Marvel Doomsday ticket opening date in India.

## November cyclone for the Chennai–Puducherry coast
Cyclone Akvan has been a significant weather event, with recent developments impacting the Chennai–Puducherry coast and surrounding regions. The cyclone intensified into a severe cyclonic storm, leading to expectations of heavy rainfall in Chennai for two days. As of November 20th, Cyclone Akvan has weakened into a cyclonic storm and has begun its land interaction along the Andhra-Odisha coast. Despite its weakening, a yellow alert has been issued for Chennai and 20 other districts in Tamil Nadu, forecasting heavy rain on November 24th. Additionally, light rain was anticipated in the Western Ghats districts of Tamil Nadu.

## Marvel Doomsday Ticket Opening Date in India
Advance bookings for 'Avengers: Doomsday' in India have commenced and are showing strong performance, with the film still 27 days away from its release. The pre-sales have been remarkable, with the advance booking collection already crossing 40 crore rupees, and some reports indicating it has reached over 42 crore rupees. More than 5.5 lakh tickets have been sold across India. This strong performance positions 'Avengers: Doomsday' as the third biggest Hollywood opener of 2026 in India based on advance bookings. Notably, some tickets are reportedly being sold for as much as 4,000 rupees.
